title: A tour of the staff app
subtitle: Home, calendar, history and profile

captions.text: Home: today's shift, open offers and the clock-in shortcut
Your next confirmed shifts are stacked under Upcoming Shift
My Space gives a quick overview of offers and confirmed shifts
Calendar: your week at a glance
Switch to Month to see every booked day
History lists completed shifts with hours and earnings
Profile holds your inbox and security settings
Notifications keep you up to date on offers and shifts
